fee_notes: Royalty is 7% of total net sales (net sales = gross sales less sales tax and use tax); late fee of $25/week plus 1.5%/month interest on overdue amounts. National Advertising Fund currently 2% of net sales; franchisor reserves right to increase to 4%. Local Advertising currently 2% of net sales, spent by franchisee on approved advertising. Brand Technology System Support Services: mandatory $840–$1,500/year (paid quarterly), plus up to $3,250/year for optional services — no flat monthly tech fee disclosed. Additional Training reimbursement up to $1,500/week per individual after first 5 persons. Pre/post-opening assistance reimbursement at cost including $100/day per diem per person.
